summary: First-finish smoke tests for Nishwa Tours & Travels: backend (3 endpoints) and frontend (booking flow + all sections/testids + mobile menu) all pass. Booking form successfully POSTs to /api/bookings and shows success toast.
passed: GET /api/ -> 200 {message: 'Nishwa Tours & Travels API is running'}
POST /api/bookings with valid payload -> 200 with UUID id and echoed fields
POST /api/bookings with invalid payload -> 422 with pydantic validation errors
GET /api/bookings -> 200 returns list sorted by created_at desc, includes new booking
Landing page loads with no console errors; all sections render
booking-form present with input-name/input-phone/input-pickup/input-drop/input-date; submit posts to /api/bookings (200) and shows success toast 'Enquiry saved! Opening WhatsApp…'
header-call-btn href=tel:7600515130; header-whatsapp-btn href contains wa.me/917600515130
floating-whatsapp-btn visible and href contains wa.me/917600515130
notes: Booking form has HTML5 date min=today attribute; past dates are blocked at browser level (expected behavior). Tested with a future date (2026-12-15) and it succeeded. WhatsApp window.open triggers after 400ms delay post-POST (blocked by browser popup policy in headless run, but success toast confirms flow works).
